values.name: Firm
values.description: Indicates that the scheduling information is a firm commitment.

values.name: Commitment for manufacturing and material
values.description: Authorizes the supplier to start the manufacturing of goods.

values.name: Commitment for material
values.description: Authorizes the manufacturer to order material required for manufacturing specified goods.

values.name: Planning/forecast
values.description: An estimate of future requirements based on trends and actual information.

values.name: Short delivered on previous delivery
values.description: Part of a consignment which was not delivered when the original delivery was made.

values.name: Capacity available
values.description: Capacity is available to meet the requested scheduling demands.

values.name: User defined
values.description: The user can interpret the meaning of the values from information exchanged previously.

values.name: Immediate
values.description: Indicates that the scheduling information is for immediate execution.

values.name: Pilot/Pre-volume
values.description: Initial products required in advance of the normal production process.

values.name: Planning
values.description: An estimate of future requirements.

values.name: Potential order increase
values.description: The possibility and magnitude of a schedule fluctuation.

values.name: Average plant usage
values.description: The usual amount that a manufacturing facility will use over a specified duration.

values.name: First time reported firm
values.description: Initial confirmation of a material requirement.

values.name: Maximum
values.description: The highest attainable amount.

values.name: Tooling capacity
values.description: The maximum amount that the process was designed to accommodate.

values.name: Normal tooling capacity
values.description: The anticipated amount that the process was designed to accommodate over a specific period of time.

values.name: Prototype
values.description: The preliminary version of a product or service.

values.name: Strike protection
values.description: Product level that is set aside as protection in the event of a work stoppage.

values.name: Required tooling capacity
values.description: The contracted amount that the process was designed to accommodate over a specific period of time.

values.name: Deliver to schedule
values.description: Deliver to schedule separately supplied.

values.name: Await manual pull
values.description: Await non-EDI instruction before shipping.

values.name: Reference to commercial agreement between partners
values.description: The buyer's commitment is the one defined in the commercial agreement.

values.name: Proposed
values.description: Indicates that the scheduling information is a proposal.
